subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises double consonants ll, ss, zz at the end of words (do-ll, fu-ss, buzz)

show.line: Doll, bell, hill. Two letters the same at the end, one sound. Fuss, kiss, hiss. Buzz, fizz, jazz!

rounds.prompt: Which word card says bell? Look for the two letters the same at the end.
rounds.praise: Yes! Bell, with a double letter at the end.

rounds.prompt: Read this word. It ends with a buzzing sound.
Which picture ends like kiss? Sss at the end.
Which word is missing? The bee says, gap.
Ends like doll, like kiss, or like buzz? Put each word in its group.

hints: Two letters the same at the end make just one sound.
Say the word slowly. Listen to the last sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write the word doll.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: d-o-l. Doll! Look, I wrote it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Doll needs two of the last letter. d-o-l-l.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's write it together. Two letters the same at the end. Doll!

parent_line: Can read and spell words that end with a double letter, like doll, kiss and buzz.
